note: L4 adds no native build and no new npm dependency. The runtime digest check (refuse on mismatch, at open AND at list) is implemented and unit-covered, but the helper digests are host-measured only: they are NOT the pinned CI image's bytes. Until every digest and trace below is real, this receipt stays blocked, never measured.

toolchain.testImage: node:24-bookworm-slim (tag only; image digest not pinned — no lane exposes it, ad-hoc docker inspection is forbidden)
toolchain.nodeGyp: never invoked in live-speech install, build, test or device paths
toolchain.nativeBuild: none — no native module in the L4 path; faster-whisper-ts stays an optional L3 peer

packageDependencies.note: Zero runtime dependencies: device/capture/control import only node:child_process, node:crypto, node:fs and node builtins.

arecord.hostDigestScope: measured on the Ubuntu qualification host — NOT the node:24-bookworm-slim image, which ships no alsa-utils
arecord.imageDigest: missing — blocked: no lane provisions arecord inside the pinned image
arecord.license: GPL-2 (separate native executable, subprocess aggregation — same treatment as the L3 eSpeak NG binary)
arecord.invocation: arecord -D <id> -f S16_LE -r <rate> -c 1 -t raw (explicit argv, shell:false; stdout streamed as PCM, stderr drained as text, no audio files)
arecord.runtimeEnforcement: ArecordDevice.open and ArecordDevice.listDevices resolve the binary to an absolute path, hash it, and refuse anything outside ARECORD_SHA256_PINS plus constructor/ARECORD_DIGESTS allowlist (DeviceOpenError on mismatch, DeviceUnavailableError when missing)

removedEntries.pw-record: Removed in r2: the previously recorded digest was a corrupted transcription (62 hex chars, not a real hash). No verified digest exists — neither in-image (no lane provisions pipewire) nor re-measured for claim — so the entry is dropped entirely instead of carrying an unverified hash. pw-record stays an unqualified alternative and is not wired.

deviceTrace.detail: The arecord -l trace was removed in r3: its content is disputed across environments (card vs device naming) and a pasted trace cannot be re-verified by review. Enumeration parsing is instead proven by unit tests over both the English and French locale forms (tests/device.test.ts, real host capture as fixture). No capture was ever attempted — no microphone in this environment, and microphone capture is forbidden in CI tests.

networkPosture.runtimeDownloads: none — audio helpers are preinstalled system binaries, not fetched artifacts; no npm audio dependency added
networkPosture.audioInTests: synthetic PCM only via FakeDevice and the node fixture binary; no audio payload in events or logs (counts, revisions, ids and text only)

sbom.delta: empty — L4 adds zero packages to package.json/package-lock.json; SBOM is the unchanged L3 set plus one hashed system binary

liveMicCapture.detail: No microphone available on the host or CI runners; live capture stays undelivered. Path: FakeDevice behavior + digest-verified arecord backend.

speakerAEC.detail: Speaker mode needs an output reference (spec §5.1), not just an amplitude threshold. Headset-only profile until a qualified AEC reference exists; speaker mode stays unavailable, never silently muted.

holdToTalk.detail: No qualified native hotkey or browser companion source in this lot: TerminalController hold mode fails closed without a real HoldSource object. Toggle, start-end and open-mic only.

inImageHelper.detail: arecord/pw-record are absent from node:24-bookworm-slim and no lane may provision them (ad-hoc docker work is forbidden). Exact missing §8.1 items: (1) pinned image digest for node:24-bookworm-slim, (2) in-image arecord digest, (3) offline execution trace inside that image, (4) network-denial log for that provisioning.
